description: Idiomatic F# facade over the Pbwire C# dynamic binding, schema at runtime, no wire code

Publish and subscribe on the free public MQTT broker broker.connectmq.com in a few lines of C#. A preconfigured MQTTnet client for TCP, TLS, WebSocket and secure WebSocket with QoS 0/1/2, retained messages, wildcards and a connectivity test. Works with private ConnectMQ brokers too.
